text:
tanya_cs: Heads up — Aurelius wants to shorten their renewal from 12mo to 9mo and convert 10 seats to a new seat class (enterprise vs standard). They like a one-time conversion credit and the PO says "invoice after signature". PO link: https://proc.aurelius/PO-9921
ben_ae: Do we have a pricing matrix for seat-class conversions? Is conversion pro-rated or treated as a one-off adjustment?
omar_fin: Need the ARR to model impact. Also delegation: up to 12% one-time credit is OK; >12% needs rev ops. What's the customer asking?
tanya_cs: ARR $96k. 9mo pro-rata = $72k. They requested a one-time $6k conversion credit (about 8.3%). They also want invoice split: 9mo term charge + separate line for conversion credit. Vendor code included in PO as VC-4433. Payment via ACH Net30.
lina_legal: If the PO references any master agreement IDs include them here. Seat-class changes should be documented in amendment; no extra clauses unless they ask. We should reference existing MSA if present.
enom:esign_bot: DocuSign envelope created DS-4501. Waiting on "finance_approved" flag to proceed.
ben_ae: I confirm the PO references MSA-AUR-2019-02. I'll attach the PO PDF to the CRM and flag account owner for signature flow preference (SSO vs email).
omar_fin: With VC-4433 and the credit at 6k this is within delegated approval. Marking finance_approved. Please ensure the credit appears as a negative line item for revenue ops tracking.
lina_legal: Drafted amendment referencing MSA-AUR-2019-02: shorten term to 9 months, add seat-class conversion table, one-time credit line. Uploading draft: https://drive.redwood/amendments/aurelius-9mo-conversion-draft
bentheAE: Customer prefers standard email signature (no SSO).
tanya_cs: Action items: (1) Ben attach PO + confirm signer email (2) Omar mark finance_approved (done) (3) Lina finalize amendment and attach to DocuSign (4) I send DocuSign and follow until signed.
esign_bot: DS-4501 updated with amendment and PO. Sent to signer at 2025-06-03T14:12Z. Envelope ID env_a12b.
ben_ae: PO attached. Signer email confirmed: procurement@aurelius.co. Sending now.
lina_legal: Quick note: amendment includes explicit billing entity "Redwood Inference, Inc." unless they ask EU entity. Ben, confirm billing entity on PO?
tanya_cs: PO indicates US billing. All set. I'll follow up once signed and then add invoice routing with revops. :thumbsup:
